system.description: The enchanted item grants +2 to Skill and Situation rolls when used. A weapon gains +1 damage, a weapon or armor +1 PV, and the item +10 Integrity. These bonuses belong to this item, not to every action of its bearer.
system.summary: The spell is woven over a designated object within range, which is then imbued with vitner that enhances its properties.
